title: setup hook --remove with no jitso entry, or no file, answers nothing to do and changes nothing
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup hook, defect N-17): jitso registers its guard in the project's .claude/settings.json without clobbering anything
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-17, setup hook). `--remove` on a file that holds only the user's hooks, and on a project with no file, prints `jitso setup hook: nothing to do (no jitso hook entries in .claude/settings.json)`, exit 0; the user's file is untouched and no backup is made. The oracle has no `setup` command: it answers `unknown command "setup"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every expectation that needs this output or file effect FAILS on it.

stdout.regex: ^jitso setup hook: nothing to do \(no jitso hook entries in \.claude/settings\.json\)\n$
^jitso setup hook: nothing to do \(no jitso hook entries in \.claude/settings\.json\)\n$
